messages:
anya: Quick design review — noticed a weird state where filter pills 'ghost' (showing as active) after toggling compare rows. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/ghost-pill.png mike: I saw that too yesterday when switching between compare tabs. Feels like state isn't clearing when you switch views. kevin: repro steps? I couldn't hit it locally. anya: Steps: open model catalog, apply 'cpu' and 'quantized' filters, select 3 rows to compare, then click 'All models' in left rail. The pills still look active but the list shows all models. sophia: That mismatch is bad for accessibility — VoiceOver will announce the pills as selected while content doesn't match. jamal: +1. Also noticed keyboard users lose focus when the compare drawer opens; the focus jumps to the top of the catalog instead of the first compared row. mike: Proposed quick fixes: 1) clear transient filter UI state on view change; 2) keep applied filters in the model list data layer but update pill visual only when list is filtered; 3) add aria-live region to announce view change. Thoughts? :thinking_face: anya: I like 1 & 2 combined. For 3 we should be careful — too many live region announcements spam screen readers. Maybe only announce when filter state and visible list diverge: "Filters cleared for this view." kevin: For keyboard focus: when opening compare drawer, set focus to the compare drawer heading with tabindex=-1 then focus() so screen readers land there. Example markup:```html

Comparing 3 models

``` sophia: That looks good. Also microcopy: currently the badge reads "Perf" — people confused it for performance vs. 'perf tier'. Suggest: "Perf (latency)" hover tooltip: "Median latency at 512 tokens, lower is better". jamal: Badge color contrast is borderline on low-key themes. Need WCAG AA. I can drop new swatches into Figma. mike: Another UX nit: pinning a model version uses the same filled-pin icon as 'pin list view' — ambiguous. Can we change version pin to a filled bookmark + label "Pinned version"? anya: Agreed, bookmark is clearer. Also add a tiny sublabel under model row: "pinned to 2025-02-14" so people know which version is fixed. sophia: Copy suggestion for empty compare state: current "No models selected" -> change to "Select up to 4 models to compare — use arrows or checkboxes" (helps keyboard discoverability). kevin: Implementation notes: will add an internal flag on route change to clear visual-only pill state, update CSS class when actual filters applied, and ensure drawer focus behavior. Planning a small migration PR. mike: Can we add a tiny persistent preference: "Remember compare selection between sessions" (off by default)? Some product folks want it but UX should opt-out. anya: OK but make it explicit in settings. For now, default behavior: do NOT persist selection across sessions, but persist across tab switches within the same session. design-bot: Action items: 1) Jamal — new badge color swatches + hover tooltip content (due Tue). 2) Kevin — PR for focus + pill-state fixes (due Mon). 3) Sophia — updated microcopy file for empty states and pin label (due Tue). 4) Mike/Anya — confirm bookmark icon + label copy (due Wed). mike: I'll mock the bookmark variant in the component library and post a preview. anya: Thanks — let's aim to ship the visual fix + a11y improvements in next patch so customers don't see ghosting. :party_popper: kevin: Will update the ticket with exact ARIA snippets and link to PR when ready. sophia: Thx all — great catch on the VoiceOver scenario.
